definition.name: list_prometheus_metric_names
definition.description: Lists metric names in a PromQL-compatible datasource (Prometheus, Thanos, Mimir, Cloud Monitoring, etc.). Filters metric names using the provided regex. Supports pagination (page * limit must not exceed 10000) and an optional time range to restrict results to metrics active within that window. Cloud Monitoring ignores the time range.

datasourceUid.description: The UID of the datasource to query

regex.description: The regex to match against the metric names

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return

startRfc3339.description: Optionally, the start time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now-1h')

endRfc3339.description: Optionally, the end time of the time range to filter the results by. Supports RFC3339 or relative time (e.g. 'now')

source.changes: description and annotations verbatim; schema converted from Go jsonschema struct tags (projectName parameter dropped where present)
